title: Camera beam image

parameters.model: Axis-aligned Gaussian spot with Poisson pixel noise, read noise, ADC clipping, and chosen image-plane calibration. No optical PSF or emittance reconstruction.

parameter_policy: All numeric model parameters are illustrative choices, not measured facility settings. Sources establish signal types and phenomena, not these parameter values.
